randomness.note: Two independent stochastic calls; no claim of bitwise reproducibility.

protocol.error_policy: No retry. Stop on HTTP errors/provider mismatch/budget violation or three consecutive connection/timeout failures; drain in-flight calls.
protocol.field_fallback: Invalid/non-stop/failed fields retain that arm/repeat input state, explicitly logged.

evaluation_rules.primary: fixed human-valid roster with explicit per-field input-state fallback
evaluation_rules.sensitivity: same actual valid-output support in both arms and both repeats
evaluation_rules.weights: current survey weight / marginal SRS inclusion probability; equal-person sensitivity
evaluation_rules.metrics: Q9 group-center MAE/RMSE, person MAE, W1, delta W1, cross-person IQR; Q8 evaluated independently
evaluation_rules.baselines: retain assigned initial state for all; observed prior only where genuinely observed
evaluation_rules.limits: A-line short chain; 3 months cannot establish time-generalization; no automatic mechanism upgrade

protocol.continuation_policy: Keep ALL prior attempts including five failures. Send only never-attempted keys once; no retry or fallback. Same stop rules.

scorer.approximation_notice: Research approximation of the Armantier et al. (2017) Appendix C generalized-beta fit, selected on a preregistered holdout; not the official FRBNY implementation. The same algorithm scores real and simulated questionnaires; differences from official headline values are reported separately.

limits: Selected mixed-entry cohort, not national SCE.
Q9 centers are across-person medians of frozen fitted density means; Q8 separate.
Real monthly previous baseline only on genuinely observed adjacent-month sources.
Retained state/normalization/failed-density fallback are explicit, not fresh model answers.
Three fixed months cannot establish generalization or a causal mechanism.
